subject: Final renewal settlement — invoice split and cross-border VAT reconciliation (Luminex)
messages:
From: Samantha Lee <samantha.lee@luminextx.com>
To: marissa.cole@redwood.com, procurement@luminextx.com
Date: 2026-10-07T08:12:00Z
Subject: Final invoice + escrow release for renewal (PO attached)

Hi Marissa,

We are ready to close the renewal for year 3 and arrange release from escrow. Attached is PO #8942 and the signed SOW amendment. Finance asked that the final invoice be split into two line items: (1) subscription (net) and (2) one-time true-up charge, each with separate invoice numbers. Also need VAT treatment confirmed — Luminex is VAT-registered in Germany (UID DE123456789) so we expect reverse-charge for the subscription, but the true-up may be treated as a taxable supply. Can you confirm how Redwood will reflect VAT and provide the final invoice language so our AP can remit?

Banking: our payment team prefers SEPA credit transfers. If any supporting tax docs are needed (TIN / VAT cert), please let us know. We are aiming to have payment processed by 2026-10-21.

Thanks,
Samantha
Samantha Lee
Director, Procurement
Luminex Therapeutics

Attachments: Luminex_PO_8942.pdf
From: marissa.cole@redwood.com <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Samantha Lee <samantha.lee@luminextx.com>, Chris Patel <chris.patel@brightlinefin.com>
Cc: priyom.das@redwood.com, laura.bennett@redwood.com
Date: 2026-10-07T10:05:00Z
Subject: Re: Final invoice + escrow release for renewal (PO attached)

Samantha — thanks for the PO and context. Drafted responses and next steps below.

1) Invoice split: we can issue two invoices as requested (INV-8942-1 subscription; INV-8942-2 true-up). I'll attach the draft invoice PDFs for your review (Redwood_inv_8942-draft.pdf). Please confirm invoice payee and billing address; I used the billing details on the PO but will update if procurement sends a different one.

2) VAT treatment: we will apply reverse charge (no VAT) on the subscription line given the German VAT registration you provided. For the true-up charge, our tax team needs to review whether it's taxable in Germany or treated as a service supplied from US. Can you confirm if the true-up relates to additional usage consumed in-Germany or to global seat adjustments?

3) Banking / SEPA: we can accept SEPA. Chris from Brightline Finance — can you confirm Redwood's SEPA beneficiary reference format and whether you require a separate remittance file for the two invoices?

4) Tax docs: please attach your VAT certificate (DE123456789) and any TIN that AP will require. If reverse-charge applies we typically need a copy of the VAT certificate + official billing contact.

Next steps: once we receive the VAT cert and confirmation on the true-up scope, Redwood tax will finalize the tax treatment within 24 business hours and I will reissue final invoices. Targeting final send by EOD 2026-10-08 to meet your 10/21 payment window.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive, Renewals 
Redwood Inference

Attachments: Redwood_inv_8942-draft.pdf
From: Chris Patel <chris.patel@brightlinefin.com>
To: marissa.cole@redwood.com, Samantha Lee <samantha.lee@luminextx.com>
Date: 2026-10-07T12:18:00Z
Subject: Re: Final invoice + escrow release for renewal (PO attached)

Hi Marissa / Samantha — copying finance.

We can process two invoices in a single payment run, but a couple of items to flag: 
- For SEPA, beneficiary must include Amazon-style IBAN reference: REDW-INF-8942. Please include that exact ref on both invoices or payments may be delayed.
- If the true-up is subject to German VAT withholding (rare), Luminex will need an indemnity form — otherwise Brightline will code net payments.
- Attached are our bank instructions and preferred remittance template.

We prefer the subscription invoice to have payment terms Net 30 and the true-up Net 14 (so you get partial remittance faster) — let me know if Redwood can accept split terms for this transaction.

Chris
Chris Patel
Head of Receivables
Brightline Finance

Subject: Fwd: Final invoice + escrow release for renewal (action: tax + ledger + remittance)

Folks — forwarding the thread from Luminex and Brightline. Summary and asks: 

- Luminex wants final invoices split into subscription + true-up; payment target 2026-10-21.
- They provided DE VAT ID; need VAT cert attached (awaiting from procurement).
- Brightline asks that both invoices include beneficiary ref REDW-INF-8942 and suggests Net 30 for subscription, Net 14 for true-up.

Actions: 
- Priyom: please confirm if Redwood can accept Net 30 / Net 14 split for this deal and whether we can accelerate collection for the true-up (either earlier invoice date or partial capture). Also confirm SEPA beneficiary formatting in our ledger exports.
- Laura: once final invoices are ready please code subscription to GL 4100-Subscriptions and true-up to GL 4205-TrueUp. We may need to create separate revenue recognition buckets for the two invoice numbers.
- Karthik: need quick tax determination: if true-up is usage allocated to Germany, we should charge German VAT; otherwise reverse-charge/no VAT. Can you advise by EOD 10/08 so I can send final invoices?

I will follow up with procurement if we still need their VAT cert, and will reissue the final PDFs once we have your inputs.

Thanks — Marissa
